description: YAGMIH crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C219 H334 Dy6 N33 O54 Zn4 3+,26(C1 H4 O1),Cl1 O4 1-,N1 O3 1-,0.5(H2 O1),Cl1 1-. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy5 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy6 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Zn1 (Zn) has 2 O neighbors; Zn2 (Zn) has 4 O neighbors; Zn3 (Zn) has 4 O neighbors; Zn4 (Zn) has 2 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 9 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.000-4.000 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 113.49-114.10°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula {[Zn4Dy6(H2L)4(HL)2(NO3)3(CH3OH)15]·2ClO4·NO3}·xCH3OH·yC2H5OH·zH2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 3 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
